info.title: Portfolio Billing API
info.description: Multistack project: this public API is Laravel. Pricing runs on Node/TypeScript and risk processing on Python. Hosted checkout requires server-side InfinitePay configuration. No automatic recurring debit.

post.description: Requested abilities narrow the role ceiling; omitted or empty abilities use role defaults. Existing tokens do not gain newly introduced abilities.

Without a free trial, creates pending_payment and an immediate initial invoice for whole remaining days up to the billing boundary on day10 America/Sao_Paulo. Access begins only after initial settlement. Existing free trials remain an exception; trial end also waits for initial payment. Monthly/quarterly/yearly cadence is retained, with renewal boundaries on day10.

Returns a stored quote_id. A valid priced quote preserves the subtotal, tax and discount for the current subscription/from/to/period and effective mode. A degraded quote remains provisional and its invoice can only be collected after automatic recalculation using current rules.

put.description: Requires quote_id from preview. Upgrades apply immediately with their quoted amounts and coupon/tax terms, recorded in a separate adjustment invoice. They revert after exhausted retries or the payment deadline, whichever comes first. A second change is blocked while an adjustment is pending. Consuming the same applied quote again does not create another invoice. Downgrades keep their quoted immediate/scheduled mode.

post.summary: Create or retrieve a hosted checkout intent

422.description: Unsupported amount/currency, not due, degraded or already settled

503.description: Gateway disabled, missing configuration or existing hosted intent conflict

post.description: Invoice must be open, due and non-degraded. Zero totals settle locally. Positive amounts require BRL >=100 cents. One intent per invoice: unknown, failed and expired intents are never recreated automatically. 202 does not mean payment succeeded; inspect checkout.status. The URL is returned only while awaiting payment and unexpired. Already paid hosted invoices return their existing state. Default gateway fake returns 503. Adjustment links cannot outlive payment_deadline_at. Unpaid adjustment expiry reverts the upgrade; later verified payments require reconciliation.

post.summary: Accept payment identifiers for asynchronous verification
post.description: Maximum body 16384 bytes. Requires transaction_nsu and either invoice_slug or slug. Public notification also requires order_nsu. Monetary fields are ignored. Unknown orders receive the same acknowledgement. Payment is settled only after server-to-server payment_check. Authenticated requests derive the order from the invoice, and can retry an exhausted reconciliation signal. Read the invoice to observe final status.

get.description: Staff only, with metrics:read. Global aggregate snapshot cached for15seconds, without customer/order/merchant identifiers. Fixed status labels; timestamps and ages use seconds. This is read-only operational monitoring, not a financial report or recurring debit metric. Database/cache failure fails the scrape rather than returning fabricated zeros.

200.description: Prometheus text exposition0.0.4; all metrics are current-state gauges, including snapshot timestamp.

Cache-Control.description: Response must not be stored by clients/proxies; internal snapshot cache is15seconds.

text/plain.example:
# HELP portfolio_billing_invoices Persisted invoices by current status.
# TYPE portfolio_billing_invoices gauge
portfolio_billing_invoices{status="open"} 0

403.description: Caller lacks metrics:read or staff capability

500.description: Metrics collection or infrastructure failure; scrape fails

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum token; x-token-ability identifies the required ability, additionally constrained by ownership.

ConfirmPlanChange.description: Pass the quote_id returned by preview to preserve the complete prorated subtotal, tax, discount and mode. Quotes are bound to subscription, from/to plans and current period; a consumed quote cannot apply twice.
